title.en: Legislative Analyst's analysis of Proposition 41, Official Voter Information Guide
Attorney General's title and summary of Proposition 41, with the Analyst's fiscal estimate, Official Voter Information Guide

explanation.en: The Analyst describes audit requirements and a limit on excluding new special-tax spending from the state spending limit, and estimates increased State Auditor costs, mostly paid from new tax revenues. It does not describe a tax increase.
